neighbours.label: the final piece of a clipped English county abbreviation (H|erts, Wil|ts, N|otts, H|ants); the full county name stays quiet
fire: Our new office is in St Albans, Herts, just off the motorway.
The fair is held each summer in Marlborough, Wilts, on the common.
Apply to the council offices in Mansfield, Notts, before June.
My grandmother grew up in Andover, Hants, during the war.
The mill stood on the river at Burnley, Lancs, until 1970.
Send the forms to the museum at Ely, Cambs, by post.
They opened a small bakery in Stroud, Glos, last year.
The choir rehearses in a church hall in Malvern, Worcs, on Tuesdays.
